## JARVIS Shop v1 - Rangéo store manager
**Top:** every new Shopify order -> Telegram alert (items, total, estimated profit, city) + memory (the JARVIS screen announces it, the morning briefing counts it).
**Bottom:** every day 8:45 (Toronto) -> paid orders not shipped after 4 days -> one alert. Silent when all is fine.
Credentials: **Shopify Access Token** (custom app, read orders) in both Shopify nodes; **JARVIS Telegram** in both Send nodes. New product? Add its CJ SKU and cost (USD, product + shipping) to COSTS in *Format order*. Settings -> Error workflow -> JARVIS Alerts v1.
